pages.text: $(#9370DB)🔮 Cosmic Infusion · Blessing of the Purple Star 🌌$()$(br2)$(l)$(#8A2BE2)「Those who drink this fragment of the galaxy may glimpse the threads of fate and mend the scars of life」$()$(br)The $(#BA55D3)amethyst cluster$()'s cosmic energy is infused into $(#B0B0B0)lunar cream$(), while $(#DAA520)amber honeydew$() carries the blessing of $(#9370DB)violets$()—a celestial miracle capable of $(l)healing the body$(), $(l)illuminating the darkness$(), and $(l)altering destiny$().

$(#8A2BE2)▌ Tri-Star Phenomenon $()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF69B4)💖 Stellar Regeneration$()$(br)Wounds bloom with $(#FF1493)rose nebula-shaped$() healing light.$(br2)$(l)$(#4169E1)👁 Awakening of the Night Eye$()$(br)Pupils reflect the $(#000080)void$(), perceiving the $(#9370DB)faintest star trails$().$(br2)$(l)$(#32CD32)🍀 Fate Shift$()$(br)A $(#7CFC00)jade-hued lucky afterimage$() follows the drinker's movements.

$(br2)$(#4B0082)▌ Astrological Brewing Method $()$(br)- Extract $(#BA55D3)stellar dust energy$() from the $(#9370DB)tip of an amethyst crystal$() using a $(#E6E6FA)crystal pickaxe$().$(br)- Soak $(#E6E6FA)violets$() in $(#B0B0B0)milk$() under $(#87CEEB)moonlight$() overnight.$(br)- Stir the mixture along the $(#FFD700)Zodiac constellations$() while blending in $(#DAA520)honey$().$(br2)$(#800080)✨$() A perfect brew will form a $(#9370DB)miniature galaxy vortex$().

$(br2)$(#483D8B)『 The Starseer's Journal 』$()$(br)An inscription found in an ancient observatory:$(br)'When $(#BA55D3)amethyst$() and $(#E6E6FA)violet$() embrace within the $(#DAA520)amber sea$(),$(br)the drinker shall gain the $(#4169E1)owl’s night vision$(), the $(#32CD32)four-leaf clover’s blessing$(),$(br)and as $(#FF69B4)wounds$() mend, they shall bloom with $(#FF1493)nebulae$()—$(br)a silent tribute from the $(#9370DB)cosmos$() to $(#8A2BE2)resilient life$().'
